svg.title: Directional geometry and relevant dimensions
svg.desc: A: a bird-feature plane (neck length by leg length) with two alternative morph trajectories 60 degrees apart from one start point, beside an illustrative sixfold model curve with peaks every 60 degrees. B: three illustrative items in a three-feature space and in the two-feature category-relevant plane, with a table showing that the nearer item to P reverses between the two distance definitions.

g.text: A: Direction through a feature space
Stripe frequency remains available for recall.
Distance models compared using hippocampal fMRI adaptation.
